antiPattern: Flat colored box labeled 'Source Code' connected to another flat box labeled 'Binary'.

visualMetaphor: Three distinct hardware silhouettes: a Desktop Workstation Monitor (Windows), a 19-inch Datacenter Rack Server with blinking LEDs (Linux), and an unfolded sleek Laptop (macOS) — each running an embedded runtime engine.
